_comment: Copy this file into your private folder (for example ..\private_validation\manual_run_paths.json) and replace every <...>. Relative paths are relative to the copied file's folder. Never commit the copy.
_recommended: Set dlm_accepted_run, batch_b_legacy_run and batch_c_accepted_run to the HISTORICAL ACCEPTED run folders named in DLM_VALIDATION_V2_GUIDE.md, ORDINAL_REFINEMENT_RUN_GUIDE.md and BATCH_C_RUN_GUIDE.md. If dlm_accepted_run is empty, DLM V2 compares with the paper output of this same run (self-reference: proves the wiring only). If batch_b_legacy_run or batch_c_accepted_run is empty, that optional comparison is not made. The summary flags every empty key.
archived_dlm_reference: <folder holding the five frozen archived DLM files>
batch_b_legacy_run: <historical accepted Batch B run folder (see ORDINAL_REFINEMENT_RUN_GUIDE.md)>
batch_c_accepted_run: <historical accepted run folder used by Batch C (see BATCH_C_RUN_GUIDE.md)>
_posthoc: Optional (post hoc steps 17-29, config/posthoc_sensitivity_protocol_v2.json). gis_ims_v8_1_reference is a folder holding the eleven declared GIS files, or a JSON array of them. Leave a key empty ("") to make its steps NOT_TESTED. nearest_station_histories is one participant-level CSV, or a JSON array of CSVs (each declared export variant is run separately; local only).
archive_engine_reference: <folder holding the five archive-engine reference files>
nearest_station_histories: <nearest-station history CSV, a JSON array of CSVs, or empty>
gis_ims_v8_1_reference: <folder of the eleven GIS files of the analysed IMS run, a JSON array of them, or empty>
